_conditional_example._comment: CONDITIONAL needs non-empty conditions + acknowledged_by, and the gate must run with --allow-conditional. Copy this block into a real verdict to see the shape.

_optional_fields._comment: Optional fields defined by ADR-0002. Omit both when they do not apply — an absent field is never an error.
_optional_fields.unblocks: Use ONLY on a fix card's verdict, to record that it discharges conditions of an EARLIER card. String or list of strings, each '<card-id>.<condition-id>', e.g. ["XJ-20261004-004.C1"]. Never reference your own id. The original CONDITIONAL verdict is never edited (PROTOCOL 6.3 R1/R2).
_optional_fields.self_signed: Set true when the verifier IS the author of the reviewed artifact. Every consumer that computes 'is this an independent authority' reads it as independent:false, so do not also set independent:true — that combination is rejected (PROTOCOL 6.3 R3). A self-signed verdict is recorded, not deleted; it just carries no authority.
